The Chinese characters for Jerry

As a transliteration, Jerry is usually written 杰里 (Jié lǐ). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

杰
Jié
outstanding
里
lǐ
inside, a mile

Origin and meaning

From Germanic, Jerry carries the meaning “rule of the spear (short form)”.

About the name Jerry

A friendly short form of Gerald or Jeremy, long common in the US.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Jerry as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “rule of the spear (short form)”, is part of the appeal.
